title: Bitaps Shamir Secret Sharing Challenge

prize.note: single P2WPKH escrow, funded across 5 transactions ending 2022-10

target_format: BIP39 12-word English mnemonic (the secret), BIP84 m/84'/0'/0'/0/0, no passphrase

derivation.summary: reconstruct a 16-byte secret from 3 of 5 Shamir shares over GF(256) (2 published, 1 needed), re-encode as a BIP39 mnemonic with its true checksum, derive BIP84 m/84'/0'/0'/0/0, compare to the escrow
derivation.certified_against: public BIP84 test vector (abandon x11 + about) and a synthetic 3-of-5 GF(256) split/reconstruct round trip; no solved sibling exists for this puzzle

difficulty_note: residual entropy is about 125 bits after every constraint I could establish (duplicate-value coefficient rejection plus a real defect in the deployed 2020 generator's entropy check); no third Shamir share has surfaced in the public record; what would close this is that missing share, or a disclosed constraint on it, not compute

leads.title: the 15-day archive gap, 2020-06-19 to 2020-07-04, uncovered by Wayback or Common Crawl
uncertified channels: archive.today, Memento TimeTravel, X replies to @bitaps_com, GitHub forks, Telegram

sources.title: Shamir Secret Backup Scheme bug bounty (challenge page)

third_party_material: the 2 published Shamir shares and the challenge-page quotes are Bitaps's own puzzle material, quoted briefly with source and date; no third-party copyrighted material is included
